# LeRobot visualize_dataset compatibility notice

DatasetUI reproduces observable behavior characterized from the Apache-2.0
Hugging Face Space `lerobot/visualize_dataset` at immutable revision
`d724744111cae6feb9a2194e607e71749813a97a`.

The upstream source is not vendored in this repository.  Exact constants and
tie-breaking rules used by the compatibility implementation are recorded in
`contracts/space-parity-goldens.json`; the immutable revision is also recorded
in `third_party/visualize_dataset.REVISION` and `contracts/space-parity.yaml`.

Upstream project: <https://huggingface.co/spaces/lerobot/visualize_dataset>
